briefs.headline: Chelsea close the friendlies against Real Sociedad
briefs.summary: The last warm-up before the season opens Aug. 21. Chelsea beat AC Milan 3-0 on Aug. 8 and drew 3-3 with Johor Darul Ta'zim the following day.

briefs.headline: Liverpool meet Como before the opener
briefs.summary: Liverpool lost 3-2 to Monaco on Aug. 9 and close the pre-season against Como on Sunday, one behind closed doors and one at Anfield.

briefs.headline: Tottenham host Hoffenheim twice in two days
briefs.summary: Spurs drew 1-1 with Getafe on Aug. 8 and take Hoffenheim on Saturday and again Sunday behind closed doors before the Aug. 21 start.

briefs.headline: Greene has a second Tommy John as the Reds edge Miami
briefs.summary: Cincinnati's ace is out for the rest of 2026 and all of 2027 after a second elbow reconstruction this week, ending a season of five starts, 27 2/3 innings and a 6.83 ERA. The Reds beat Miami 1-0 on Friday, Chase Burns going to 14-2 with a 2.47 ERA.
briefs.note: Cross-checked against SI's Reds coverage, which agrees on the second Tommy John, the 2026-27 absence and the 27 2/3 innings / 6.83 ERA line. They disagree on his age (26 v 27) and on the year of his first Tommy John (2018 v 2019), so neither was printed. The 1-0 result and Burns' record come from mlb.com/scores.

briefs.headline: Browns open the preseason at Chicago
briefs.summary: Kickoff is 1 p.m. Saturday at Soldier Field. Buffalo and New England follow at home on Aug. 22 and Aug. 27.

briefs.headline: Marshall host Ohio on Sunday, and both are ours
briefs.summary: The Herd opened with a 3-1 win over Morehead State on Thursday and take the Bobcats at 7 p.m. It is the one fixture this paper writes down the middle.

briefs.headline: Pirates put up eight on Boston
briefs.summary: Pittsburgh won 8-4, Bubba Chandler taking the decision to go to 6-8 and Jake Bennett falling to 7-6.

briefs.headline: No. 20 West Virginia opens with a 2-0 win over Dayton
briefs.summary: Sophia Nickel scored 54 seconds into the second half Thursday and an own goal off a Maya Leoni corner doubled it. The men open Aug. 20 at Charlotte.

coming_in.item: WVDNR lists a gun bear season opening Aug. 29 in SELECTED COUNTIES only. The county list is not in the pamphlet's summary table, so no county is named here. Season limit 2, daily limit 1; bag limits vary by county and permit class and are on pamphlet pages 33-39.

notes.item: Flounder is closed in North Carolina coastal waters and unlawful to possess. Topsail Sound is coastal water, so Marine Fisheries governs it, not the inland digest.
Nothing else opens within two weeks. The first general season is squirrel on Sept. 12, with a youth weekend Sept. 5-6.
Goose, duck, dove, woodcock and snipe dates are not in the summary table. They come from a separate WVDNR migratory bird publication issued in August, and HIP registration is required.

sections.standing_note: The pamphlet is a summary. The West Virginia Code and the Code of State Rules control and win any conflict. Dates here are for the 2026-27 season year and expire June 30, 2027.

sections.label: On the Water

waters.working: Low and clear, so the pocket water and plunge pools are the whole river. Long leader, small caddis dry, and a light stonefly nymph through the deeper pockets; a sculpin pattern on the undercut banks.

waters.near: 14 miles above R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.read: 25.5 ft and falling - normal pool. Ordinary bank access.
waters.working: Normal pool fishes structure. Shad are the forage, so a white swimbait along the wing dams and the riprap, and a crawfish-coloured crankbait tight to the rock.

waters.near: below R.C. Byrd Locks and Dam
waters.read: 27.9 ft and falling - up and pushing. Expect colour and current; fish the slack behind anything solid.
waters.working: Up and coloured, so the fish are out of the current. Work the slack behind the wing dams, the barge cuts and the lock wall rather than the open channel.

waters.reading: Sound highs 10:57 a.m. and 11:19 p.m.; lows 5:09 a.m. and 5:24 p.m., at Hampstead.
waters.read: Fish the moving water either side of high at 10:57 AM and 11:19 PM in the sound.
waters.working: Tide first: the water moving off the 10:57 a.m. high is the window. Mud minnows, shrimp and finger mullet are the forage, so work the grass edges and oyster bars, and the dock lights on the late high.
waters.note: Hampstead is the sound station and is the read that matters; the oceanfront station at Ocean City Beach pier runs over an hour ahead and is quoted only for a surf read. No water temperature is carried today - the Wrightsville Beach gauge returned none.

sections.note: USGS does not gauge the Ohio at R.C. Byrd, and the Corps tailwater data is not reachable from this pipeline. The two gauges above are the ones that bracket the dam, and neither is the tailwater.

kicker: First edition. Sport was thin on a Friday in August; the calendar and the gauges carry it.
